script.description: Normalize dot_number into the canonical unpadded string carriers uses, so the crashes-enrichment-policy's internal enrich index stores a clean '2975796' rather than a value that would not term-match carriers' dot_number. Handles a String because the loader now reads every CSV column with dtype=str; the earlier '(long) ctx.dot_number' cast worked only on the float pandas used to produce and threw ClassCastException on a String, which ignore_failure then swallowed, leaving the field untouched and this processor a silent no-op. A 'convert' processor is still wrong here: it calls Long.parseLong() on the string form, which throws on a decimal-point value like '3240797.0' -- the shape this sees whenever a source column carries a NaN and pandas widens it to float64. Stripping at the decimal point covers both shapes. The parse runs for its normalizing side effect, not for its type: the result is assigned back as a String because an enrich index reindexes _source verbatim and compares it as a keyword, so the rendered string is the join key and every dataset on both sides of it must produce the same one.
script.source: if (ctx.dot_number == null) { return; } String raw = String.valueOf(ctx.dot_number); int dot = raw.indexOf('.'); if (dot >= 0) { raw = raw.substring(0, dot); } if (raw.isEmpty()) { return; } ctx.dot_number = String.valueOf(Long.parseLong(raw));
